changes.title: Bill Cassidy Will Back Todd Blanche as Attorney General, Salvaging His Confirmation

changes.title: Todd Blanche Clears Committee Vote, Nearing Confirmation as Attorney General
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination now advances to the Senate floor, where it was not immediately clear whether he would be confirmed given that he can afford to lose only two senators on a party-line vote.

changes.title: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche issues order rescinding "anti-weaponization" fund
changes.summary: The order came after Republican Senators Thom Tillis and John Cornyn threatened to block Blanche's confirmation for Attorney General if the fund was not rescinded in writing.
